failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build with clang-tidy enabled failed: 2 clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements errors treated as warnings-as-errors in remove_redundant_reorders.cpp

failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check failed because the Build-gpu clang-tidy job failed

key_errors:
remove_redundant_reorders.cpp:156:86: error: statement should be inside braces [readability-braces-around-statements,-warnings-as-errors]
  156 |                     if (!usr->is_type<reorder>() || &usr->get_dependency(0) != &node)
      |                                                                                      ^
  157 |                         continue;
7190 warnings generated. 2 warnings treated as errors; ninja: build stopped: cannot make progress due to previous errors.
root_cause: PR #38641 adds new code to remove_redundant_reorders.cpp (pinning the output_format of a reorder's downstream user before the reorder node is removed) using single-statement if bodies without braces: `if (!usr->is_type<reorder>() || &usr->get_dependency(0) != &node) continue;` and `if (usr_prim->output_format == format::any) usr_prim->output_format = output_layout.format;`. The repository's clang-tidy configuration enables readability-braces-around-statements and treats clang-tidy warnings as errors on the dedicated clang-tidy build variant, so these unbraced single-line if bodies fail the 'Cmake build with clang-tidy enabled' step, which fails the aggregate ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy check. This is the second merge-queue run to hit the exact same two unfixed lines in the PR; the braces have not yet been added since the prior investigation (run 44245354283, ~2h20m earlier).
reproduction_steps: Build locally with -DENABLE_CLANG_TIDY=ON (same compile flags as the Build-gpu/clang-tidy job) or run `clang-tidy-18 --config-file=.clang-tidy src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/remove_redundant_reorders.cpp -- <same compile flags as in CI>` to reproduce the two readability-braces-around-statements errors at lines 156 and 159 of the PR's version of the file.
recommended_actions: Add braces around both single-statement if bodies in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/remove_redundant_reorders.cpp: `if (!usr->is_type<reorder>() || &usr->get_dependency(0) != &node) { continue; }` and `if (usr_prim->output_format == format::any) { usr_prim->output_format = output_layout.format; }`
Re-run clang-tidy locally (or push and watch the clang-tidy CI job) before re-adding the PR to the merge queue
This is a recurring (2nd) failure of the same unfixed code; the PR author should push the fix before the next merge-queue attempt rather than relying on re-runs
prevention_strategies: Always brace single-statement if/for/while bodies in new code touching src/plugins/intel_gpu (and any other component built with -DENABLE_CLANG_TIDY=ON), matching the project's clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements rule. Run the project's .clang-format/clang-tidy checks locally before pushing, especially for files under directories covered by the clang-tidy CI build variant.
historical_context: Exact repeat of pattern a4282c65071120e2, first recorded in run 44245354283 (investigation 2026-11-18-06-08-56-174-44245354283) on the same PR #38641, same two unbraced if statements, same clang-tidy errors. The underlying code issue was never fixed between the two merge-queue attempts.
